Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional kitchen timer with a clear display, an annoying beep, and buttons difficult to press with wet hands. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I bought this timer hoping for simplicity. The display is wonderfully clear—I can read it from across the kitchen. But the beep? Ear-splitting and relentless. Worse, the buttons are nearly impossible to press with wet hands. I’ve burned two batches of cookies fumbling to silence it. If you bake often, skip this one.
